title: Column scale and stats
description: A tinted mono eyebrow over a hairline rule, then a 28px two-tone statement (navy lead-in fading into soft grey), a muted paragraph and a white button on the left with a wide chart art area on the right. Four big teal figures with small captions run along the bottom; they blur, rise and fade in one after another as they scroll into view.
notes: media fills the chart area; empty, it's a soft highlight wash with a faint dot grid
the figure reveal is a CSS view timeline (scrubbed with the scroll); without support or with reduced motion they simply show
